verdict.rationale: Godot's docs provide a static class reference with GDScript/C# code snippets (e.g. godot-docs-1, godot-docs-5, godot-docs-20), but there is no evidence of an interactive, runnable API reference (no in-browser sandbox, no OpenAPI/interactive explorer) — probes explicitly show no llms.txt, no markdown API, and no OpenAPI spec (godot-probe-1, godot-probe-2, godot-probe-3).
